story.title: 'Ramayana: Part 1': Namit Malhotra gets emotional at Mumbai screening
story.summary: Namit Malhotra became emotional while expressing gratitude at the Mumbai screening of 'Ramayana: Part 1'. He described the film as his heartbeat and highlighted its significance for the team. Malhotra acknowledged the hard work and passion that went into creating the film. Audience reactions after the screening were positive, particularly regarding the visual elements and performances.

story.summary: Kareena Kapoor is the daughter of actors Randhir Kapoor and Babita Kapoor. She made her debut with Refugee, directed by JP Dutta.

story.title: Governor presents Unit Citations to Air Force Station, Avadi, 27 Special Composite Group of National Security Guard
Suriya's 'Scene' makers thank CM Vijay; leads 6 AM ticket booking
story.summary: Suriya's much-anticipated film 'Scene' has secured approval for six daily screenings during its debut week, a decision that has been positively received by both producers and theater owners. Ticket sales are particularly strong for the early morning 6 AM shows. In contrast, Nayanthara's 'Mookuthi Amman 2' has also launched its 6 AM screenings but is experiencing a more modest reception.

‘Very few complaints’ received so far on police brutality during July 20 protests, says Supreme Court
story.summary: The ATR said the lack of complaints from the protesters was despite repeated public notices that the grievances would be maintained confidentially, and would only be accessible to the Chairperson and HPEC members
